metadata.datasource: Kodak publication F-4018 (May 2007), vector paths of p7 (D-76 small-tank characteristic curves, 5/7/11 min), p8 (contrast index vs time) and p9 (spectral sensitivity).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 381-661 nm: the D = 0.30 above D-min curve (solid); ASSUMED held below 381 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0699 dex/nm above 661 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.94..1.84 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, to contrast index 0.56 (time read off the sheet's own D-76 contrast-index line): 5.5 min, interpolated between the plotted 5 and 7 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.634); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.431 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 125 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/125)+1.0 = -1.194 log lux-s
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0064 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
